title: The Super Bowl Is Returning to LA!
description:
The Super Bowl is returning to Los Angeles just five years after its last visit. Hosting one of the world’s biggest sporting events brings major benefits to the region, from boosting tourism and supporting local businesses to building excitement and civic pride.

Beyond the economic impact, Los Angeles is also using the event to create more opportunities for local youth. Organizers are expanding access to flag football through programs designed to make participation more affordable and accessible for kids across the region.

By bringing the big game back to Los Angeles, the city is showing young people that there are many ways to be part of the world of sports—whether they dream of playing on the field, working behind the scenes, or reporting on the action.

The Super Bowl may last just one day, but its impact can help support local businesses, strengthen communities, and create new opportunities for the next generation.
